item_short_desc: Rothco's EMT Medical Trauma Kit is packed with over 200 essential first aid supplies, perfect for first responders and emergency medical personnel. The durable EMT bag measures 22" x 11" x 11 1/2" and features a large main compartment with a removable organizer, along with 8 additional pockets and pouches for securely storing medical equipment and supplies. The shaped zipper flap opening allows for easy access to the contents, while the rear 6-loop bandolier provides space for attaching extra gear.
description: Rothco's EMT Medical Trauma Kit is packed with over 200 essential first aid supplies, perfect for first responders and emergency medical personnel. The durable EMT bag measures 22" x 11" x 11 1/2" and features a large main compartment with a removable organizer, along with 8 additional pockets and pouches for securely storing medical equipment and supplies. The shaped zipper flap opening allows for easy access to the contents, while the rear 6-loop bandolier provides space for attaching extra gear. For added convenience, the kit includes an adjustable and removable shoulder strap and a top carry handle. The top flap features a prominent white cross, making it easily identifiable in emergency situations. Please note that this item has hazmat restrictions and cannot be shipped via air freight. Contact Rothco for further shipping details.
